organizing_principle: Literally build a path forward for the State of Arkansas — from the existing balance sheet and operating system to the proposed Constitutional Capitalism state, without inventing the missing middle.

volume_i.name: The Unabridged Constitutional Capitalism System
volume_i.standard: Could a governor, economist, lawyer, legislator, university researcher, agency director, entrepreneur, skeptic, or future AI reconstruct exactly what we mean and test every important claim?

volume_ii.name: The Public Book
reader_arc: Why the current structure produces the outcomes it does
What life looks like for households
volume_ii.cross_reference_rule: Every major section points back to Unabridged sections (e.g. For fiscal model, assumptions and source data, see Unabridged §X.Y).

stages.name: Full First Pass
stages.target: Every component has an actual working model

stages.name: Unabridged Completion
stages.target: Every category written to exhaustive source-of-truth quality

stages.name: Validation / Break It
stages.target: Legal, economic, fiscal, political, resilience and implementation testing

stages.name: Public Book
stages.target: Compress the validated system into the ~100-page public roadmap

stages.name: Implementation Manuals
stages.target: Administration-specific plans, legislative packages, agency transitions, local pilots, fiscal schedules, dashboards

arkansas_development_program_roadmap.rule: Every policy module plugs into this transition. The unabridged book is an Arkansas development program, not forty disconnected policy chapters.
forced_questions: What can coexist with the existing system?
What public assets must exist before revenue changes?
Which should begin as local pilots?
What does it begin doing that does not exist today?
arkansas_development_program_roadmap.administration_standard: A future Arkansas administration should be able to pick up the unabridged version and use it as a map for moving from the existing state to the proposed state without having to invent the missing middle.

arkansas_state_baseline_rule.posture: Acquire and organize now; analyze as later modules need. Do not stop Pass 2 to analyze every budget line.
arkansas_state_baseline_rule.starting_premise: The actual State of Arkansas is the starting balance sheet and operating system — not a theoretical government from scratch.

pass_2_concurrent_infrastructure: Build Progress / Pass Change Log system
Arkansas State Baseline / Budget Corpus acquisition and organization
